body:
This is definitely not my first time taking this, as me and my friend split a large order of this online about a year ago.
My friend was more interested in selling for extra cash, but I was more interested in using it to get through my difficult Engineering program in University. I had first tried it in high school, when my friend had ordered a small amount of it online from a vendor he had worked for in the past. Initially he had given me 60mg doses, because that's what he used and he is a fair amount smaller than me (I was 180lb and he was about 150 at the time), but that seemed too much as a study drug for me. 60mg seemed to get me almost more attention deficit than I usually am, and I found myself playing video games (quite a bit better and quicker than usual) for hours instead of reading my textbook.
When we split the order, I also purchased a milligram scale, scoops and empty capsules so I could do the measuring in the comfort of my own home.
I also purchased a milligram scale, scoops and empty capsules so I could do the measuring in the comfort of my own home.
I decided that because 60mg seemed too much, I could try different dosages to find what's right for me: starting with 30mg. 30mg was quite subtle but the effects were noticeable for the short period of time it lasted (approximately 3-4hrs of noticeable effects).
Next was 40mg, and this was a good dosage, it lasted closer to 6 hours and it was a fair bit more noticeable without being recreational, but I wasn't done experimenting yet.
Once I take more that 30mg the only negative side effect I seem to notice is a raised heart rate (not enough to worry, just noticeable), minor sweating, and the extreme loss of appetite, sometimes lasting for days afterwards. Food doesn't seem to cross my mind, and when it does, nothing seems appetizing. Even my favourite food will seem mediocre in my mind, and not worth eating. I usually like to eat a large meal before taking it, not only because it's healthy to eat with any sort of stimulant, but because I most likely won't want to eat for at least the duration of the drug.
I decided that 40mg was probably what I would use for studying, but I wanted to do more experimenting. I upped my dosage to 50mg which was a noticeable difference: everything was more interesting, but I had not yet gotten to the point of becoming distracted. Homework was interesting, talking to people was interesting, reading was interesting and I was very comfortable feeling but I was still focused on the task I had given myself. Although 50mg was much more pleasant than 40mg, I decided that it was a little too recreational for studying purposes, and I really don't want to get addicted to a drug that I have access to a lot of (seems like a recipe for disaster).
So I settled on 45mg of 2-FMA orally as a useful, and not too recreational study drug.
All in all it is a very useful study drug, and a quite pleasant, yet subtle recreational drug. This drug should be used with extreme caution
!
